name: first-use
source: Hand-written from ADR 0230, Decision: optional firstOpenedAt follows legacy startDate and precedes plan; exact case variants remain unknown.

name: unicode-separators
source: Hand-written expected bytes from ADR 0230, Decision, extending ADR 0200, Decision and Verification: record text and unknown keys preserve U+2028/U+2029 using explicit escapes, including text also holding LF.

name: empty
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Document, Keys. A record that holds only a version writes the version and `kind`.

name: ada
source: Hand-written. The harness example record. Contract rules: Keys, Scalars (UUID, hash, date, and timestamp start with a digit and are quoted), Outcomes. 0090: the file form.

name: identity
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys, Scalars. A hash that starts with a letter and a URL are plain, a digit-led account is quoted.

name: quoting
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Scalars, applied to every text field of a record. The word `deferred` is quoted in every field except `outcome`. Reserved words come from 0030's format guards.

name: multiline
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Multi-line strings, inside an answer and inside an outcome list item.

name: answers
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Answers, shared with the plan encoder. Names come from the plan encoder's `answers` fixture.

name: sections-only
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Keys. An empty plan map and a section with no answers are omitted.

name: omit-zero
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Keys, zero values are omitted. An outcome that holds only a section is not empty.

name: partial-items
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys. Each field of an outcome alone keeps the outcome from being empty, and a plan reference writes each field on its own.

name: plan-url-only
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Keys. The plan reference is written when any of its fields is set.

name: outcome-fields
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Outcomes. Key order `section`, `outcome`, `on`, `sectionHash`, `note`, `differently`, with the optional ones.

name: outcome-order
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Outcomes are written in the order the record holds them, repeats and unknown words included. 0090: the recorder sorts them, the encoder does not.

name: unknown-fields
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys, Unknown field values. `id`, `sections`, `directory`, `provenance`, and `variables` are unknown fields of a record. Same value shapes as the plan encoder's `unknown-fields` fixture.

name: empty-answer
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Problems. Paths in the order of the canonical file, which sorts the keys of the maps.

name: empty-item
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Problems. An outcome that would write no keys is reported. An outcome with a section and nothing else is not.

name: collision
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Problems. The seven keys of a record collide, `id` and `sections` do not. Reported in ascending key order.

name: problem-order
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Problems come in the order of the places in the canonical file: answers, outcomes, then unknown fields.
